title: Partial bind failure rolls back the complete Static bundle
blocker: Standalone VFIO-provider and durable lease/FSM components now provide bounded premises, but a production Static controller has not integrated authoritative inventory, real bind/reset compensation, original-owner restoration, or post-rollback identity/DMA/IRQ verification under an injected mid-bind failure.
assertions: the complete authoritative dependency bundle is leased before the first bind side effect
an injected failure after any member bind runs compensations in reverse order
the original owners, identity, DMA and IRQ state are read back before a clean rollback releases the lease
uncertain compensation retains the whole-bundle claim and enters quarantine rather than FREE
